NTDC-PROC-2026-441.content: Instructions to Bidders - Supply of lattice towers, steel structures and hardware for 220kV D/C transmission line Lot-2 (Ref: NTDC-PROC-2026-441). Scope: Supply of galvanized lattice towers, steel structures, insulator strings, conductor hardware and associated fittings for 220kV double circuit transmission line Lot-2, complete with testing at factory before dispatch. Eligibility: Bidders shall hold a valid PEC licence in category C-A. The bidder must have completed at least 3 similar supply contracts of comparable value in the last 10 years. The bidder must have an average annual turnover of PKR 900,000,000. Tender fee: PKR 12,000 payable in cash before collection of documents. Bid security: Bid security of PKR 8,000,000 shall be furnished in the form of a bank guarantee valid for 120 days from the date of opening. Last date of submission of bids: 10-Nov-2026 at 1100 hours. Bids will be opened on 11-Nov-2026 at 1200 hours. Price: Prices shall be firm and fixed. No price adjustment shall be allowed for the contract period. Liquidated damages for delay shall apply at 0.05 percent of the contract price per day, capped at 5 percent. Warranty: The contractor shall provide a defect liability period of 12 months from delivery. An advance payment of 10 percent of the contract price shall be released against an irrevocable advance payment guarantee. Insurance: The contractor shall arrange marine and transit insurance for the supplied material. All disputes shall be settled by arbitration under ICC rules with the seat of arbitration in Singapore.

General Conditions of Contract - NTDC Lot-2 lattice tower supply. Clause 8: The Employer may terminate the contract for convenience on 30 days written notice to the Contractor. Clause 14: The Contractor shall furnish performance security equal to 5 percent of the contract price within 28 days of contract signature. Clause 19: The Contractor's liability under this Contract shall be without limitation of amount. Clause 22: Retention money of 5 percent shall be deducted from each running bill and released on the certificate of substantial completion. Clause 25: The Employer reserves the right to suspend the Works at its convenience. Clause 27: The Contractor shall be responsible for all taxes, duties and withholding tax on any payment under this Contract. Clause 30: The Contractor shall be responsible for any local employment obligations and shall deploy Pakistani staff. Clause 33: All disputes shall be referred to arbitration under the Rules of Arbitration of the International Chamber of Commerce with the seat of arbitration being Singapore.

NTDC-PROC-2026-455.content: Instructions to Bidders - Rehabilitation and augmentation of 132kV substations at Sahiwal and Okara including transformer replacement (Ref: NTDC-PROC-2026-455). Scope: Replacement of power transformers, refurbishment of protection panels, earthing improvement and civil repair works at 132kV substations Sahiwal and Okara. Eligibility: Bidders shall hold a valid PEC licence in category C-A and shall have a valid affidavit of non-blacklisting. The bidder must have completed at least 4 similar works of comparable magnitude in the last 10 years. The bidder must have an average annual turnover of PKR 1,200,000,000. Tender fee: PKR 15,000. Bid security: Bid security of PKR 12,000,000 in the form of a bank guarantee from a scheduled bank, valid for 120 days from the date of opening of bids. Last date of receipt of bids: 25-Nov-2026 at 1000 hours. Date of opening of bids: 26-Nov-2026 at 1100 hours. Price: The price shall be on a firm price, fixed price without price adjustment basis. Liquidated damages at 0.05 percent of the contract price per day shall apply for delay, subject to an overall cap of 10 percent. Performance security of 5 percent of the contract price shall be furnished. Retention money of 5 percent shall be deducted from running bills. The Employer reserves the right to terminate the contract for convenience. The Contractor's liability under this Contract shall be without limitation of amount. Advance payment of 15 percent of the contract price shall be paid on commencement against an advance payment guarantee. All disputes shall be settled by arbitration under ICC rules with the seat of arbitration in Singapore. The Employer may suspend the Works at its convenience. The Contractor shall arrange third party liability insurance and shall bear all taxes and withholding tax.
